instrument: SNTS Style track (clone) / Kick (G) / StandardCLIP / Clipping (threshold) -- INVERSE-TABLE VALIDATION
hypothesis: VALIDATION of MAP.md Row-2 inverse table (target-crest -> Clipping value) as a real control, not just a description. The table predicts crest 5.0/6.0/7.0 dB at Clipping 0.750/0.766/0.782 (these are evenly spaced, 0.016 apart, so one 3-step sweep hits all three). 0.766 and 0.782 are OFF the original 0.025-grid (interpolated), so a match tests interpolation + reproducibility together. Same single-variable rig as snts_kick_clip_thresh_v1: Decapitator devices[1] OFF, StandardCLIP devices[6] ON, Input/Output Gain 0.833, Softness 0.383, Clip Type 'Soft Clip Pro'. PASS = each measured crest_db within ~0.3 dB of its target (5.0, 6.0, 7.0).
